name: Adira Strongheart
description: Leader of Robaran Mercenaries who frees Johan.

description_citations.text: "Shauku". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ramirez and Tor Wauki fight Adira's Robaran Mercenaries, strand them, then plunder Koltos.
timeline.quote: After an initial victory stranding the Robarans on a sandbank, they sailed to Koltos

citation.text: "Ramirez DePietro", section "Plundering Koltos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Adira Strongheart's mercenaries free Johan; Jedit Ojanen knocks Shauku back and the freed Cosmic Horror summons a Falling Star that obliterates the ruin.
timeline.quote: the freed Cosmic Horror summoned a Falling Star to obliterate the entire ruin.

citation.text: "Shauku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan captures the Robaran Mercenaries, but Hazezon shifts away and the city-states build a skyship fleet.
timeline.quote: Unbeknownst to him, Hazezon had learned to shift (to teleport) and was, therefore, able to escape.

citation.text: "Johan", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the final battle at Efrava, Johan turns Hazezon's spell against him and tears out Adira's heart.
timeline.quote: he killed Adira Strongheart by ripping her heart out of her chest with his bare hands.

citation.text: "Johan", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nightstalkers sent by Johan ambush Hazezon and Adira, changing Adira's mind to help Bryce.
timeline.quote: The ambush fails, but this changes Adira's mind and she decides that Palmyra will help Bryce.

citation.text: "Johan (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Robarans overthrow Lucrezian marines on a secret island with the enslaved islanders and sell the warships to Fysmatan.
timeline.quote: together, the two forces overthrow the marines, capturing the warships and selling them to Fysmatan for a great sum.

citation.text: "Johan (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hazezon seals a pact with Beckoner, ending the merfolk attacks on Palmyra.
timeline.quote: Hazezon can seal a pact with Beckoner, shaman of the tribe Born of the Beck.

citation.text: "Johan (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hazezon seeks alliances with other city-states, including his ex-wife Adira of Palmyra.
timeline.quote: Hazezon sought an alliance with several other city-states

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Palmyra is drawn into the war after a botched ambush; the Robarans led by Adira raid ships to finance the war.
timeline.quote: Palmyra initially refused to help due to its neutrality but was eventually drawn into the war after a botched ambush.

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Palmyra Johan deceives Jedit and unleashes his bloodlust against Hazezon and Adira; the Robarans reveal Jaeger was their friend and Jedit nearly kills Johan, who escapes with Beasts of Bogardan.
timeline.quote: Johan summoned Beasts of Bogardan to escape.

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan is tricked into an enchantment and imprisoned at Shauku's castle, where she reveals she is a vampire who manipulated him; Adira accidentally frees him and the castle is destroyed by a Falling Star.
timeline.quote: After Adira accidentally freed Johan, the group escaped

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan builds a fleet of airships powered by powerstones to invade Bryce, Efrava and the surrounding regions, while the resistance gathers allies and secures airships of its own.
timeline.quote: Johan sought to expand his dominion by constructing a fleet of airships powered by powerstones.

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the final confrontation Johan slays Adira but is dragged from the sky by Jedit and devoured by a colossal sand wurm, ending the war.
timeline.quote: Johan slew Adira but was ultimately dragged from the sky by Jedit.

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Palmyra Johan lies that Hazezon and Adira killed Jaeger and sends Jedit, under spells, to attack them; the spells conflict and the Robarans reveal the truth.
timeline.quote: permitting the Robaran Mercenaries to reveal to him that Jaeger was their good friend

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jedit joins Adira's Circle of Seven; Hazezon shifts them atop the mountains and stays behind.
timeline.quote: Jedit is enlisted in Adira's Circle of Seven

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Robarans infiltrate Shauku's castle; Adira frees Johan, Jedit incapacitates Shauku, and they escape as the Falling Star destroys the castle.
timeline.quote: After Jedit incapacitates Shauku

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The survivors prepare to return home to stop Johan's conquest.
timeline.quote: prepare to return home and stop Johan's plan of conquest

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jedit, Hazezon, Adira and the Seveners infiltrate Tirras to assassinate Johan but are captured; Hazezon and Adira are imprisoned, the rest sent to a work camp where Jedit learns of airships.
timeline.quote: they are quickly discovered and captured

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Robarans steal an airship, rouse the slaves, rescue Hazezon and Adira, but Johan's storm throws them off course.
timeline.quote: The Robarans manage to steal a ship, rouse the slaves, and sail through the air toward Tirras.

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ship is thrown against a Magnetic Mountain, killing many, and the survivors resolve to travel on foot to the sea.
timeline.quote: killing a lot of its passengers

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jedit is rescued and taken to Bryce, where the fleet needs powerstones; Adira and Jedit sail for Koltos.
timeline.quote: Adira and Jedit sail towards the island of Koltos

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jedit and Adira fly to Efrava, where Jedit's claim to be the first Ojanen is met coldly; he seeks help from other cat tribes and gains the Hooraree and Sulaki.
timeline.quote: he manages to make a tenuous covenant with the Hooraree

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan attacks Efrava; Jedit, now general of the Efravans, leads guerrilla warfare and allied reinforcements retake the village, and Adira devises a plan to attack Johan's ship.
timeline.quote: the alliance manages to recapture the village of the Efravans

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Robarans reach Johan's flagship; Adira stabs Johan but is killed by him; Jedit and Johan fall to the desert where a sand wurm eats Johan.
timeline.quote: a sand wurm emerges from the dunes and eats him

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Johan kills Adira after surviving her stab

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Killed her in the final battle.
relations.quote: he killed Adira Strongheart by ripping her heart out of her chest with his bare hands.

relations.note: Johan slays Adira in the final confrontation.

relations.quote: Ramirez had a past with Adira Strongheart which was left purposely vague.

pages_say.description: Leader of the Circle of Seveners who devises the plan to attack Johan's ship and is killed by him.
